extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders and organisations interested in Singapore's climate policy and the REACH public consultation
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit feedback to the NCCS public consultation on REACH Singapore (Singapore's decarbonisation journey), addressing climate ambition, transition to a low‑carbon economy, and proposed decarbonisation measures within the consultation period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission period / deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Taking place from 8 Oct to 5 Nov 2024, NCCS has launched a public consultation on REACH Singapore to gather views on Singapore’s decarbonisation journey.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit feedback within the stated consultation window (8 Oct–5 Nov 2024). Submissions after the closing date will not be part of this consultation. Use the provided feedback link (https://go.gov.sg/feedbacksgdecarb) to submit during the open period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of feedback / topics to address
rubrics_metrics.description: This includes Singapore’s climate ambition, our transition towards a low‑carbon economy and the decarbonisation measures we will undertake.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus comments on the consultation topics (climate ambition, transition approaches, and decarbonisation measures). Keeping responses on‑topic increases relevance to the policy development process.

rubrics_metrics.name: How submitted views will be used
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitted views will be taken into consideration as Singapore develops the next bound of climate targets, measures and policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributions inform the development of targets, measures and policies; they are considered by officials but are not guaranteed to result in specific changes. Make clear, evidence‑based suggestions if you want them to be weighed more heavily.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use official, secure channels / verify website authenticity
rubrics_metrics.description: Official website links end with .gov.sg. Trusted websites Secure websites use HTTPS Look for a lock () or https:// as an added precaution. Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify you are submitting via official NCCS/government channels (e.g., links ending in .gov.sg or the provided go.gov.sg feedback link). Do not share sensitive personal information on non‑secure or unauthorised sites. Prefer HTTPS and look for the browser lock icon before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary submission link / where to find more information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified short link to access the consultation materials and submission form. Consult supporting materials at that link to ensure your feedback addresses the consultation questions and any requested formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check consultation status before acting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm the consultation's current status (open/closed) before preparing or attempting to submit feedback. The page indicates closures for past consultations and dates for the active consultation.
